meta.name: mechanism-builder
meta.description: Use when you need to explain why your solution works and others failed. Trigger on "unique mechanism", "why this works", "different angle", "positioning".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解释方案为何有效并突出独特优势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要向客户或团队清晰解释方案的独特竞争力。
copy.tagline_en: Explain why your solution works and highlight unique advantages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to clearly explain your solution's unique competitiveness to clients or team.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你分析为什么之前的方案失败，并设计一个独特的机制来解释你的方案为何有效。它会输出失败方法、新机制、机制名称和原因。
howto.when: 当你提到“独特机制”、“为什么有效”、“不同角度”或“定位”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我解释为什么我的方案比竞品有效。
say.note: Claude 会分析竞品失败原因并构建你的机制。

say.text: 为什么之前的尝试都失败了？
say.note: Claude 会识别失败方法并给出新机制。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you analyze why previous solutions failed and design a unique mechanism to explain why your solution works. It outputs Failed Method, New Mechanism, Mechanism Name, and Why It Works.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "unique mechanism", "why this works", "different angle", or "positioning".

say_en.text: Explain why my solution works better than competitors.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze competitor failures and build your mechanism.
Claude will identify failed methods and propose a new mechanism.
